audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 1 and 6 disagree with the packet on both layers. Chart reads [Sion, Skill, Mordekaiser x5]; packet levelChart is [Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Skill] at a 55.04% win rate over 3044 games. The page's own prose already matches the packet: whys[0] 'neither has an all-in, so farm', whys[1] 'out-trades his lone E shield-break poke', whys[6] 'He never out-scales you 1v1, but... real teamfight engage'.
audit.why: Sion has no level-1 all-in — a charged Decimating Smash is telegraphed and Mordekaiser has no reason to stand in it. At two-plus items Sion stops being a lane problem and becomes a 7500-range engage tool, which is a different kind of threat, not a lane loss.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Level 2 Mordekaiser, 2+ items Skill; rows 2-5 unchanged. Matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Four spikes present and real: Lvl 2-3 Q+W, Lvl 6 Realm of Death (140/120/100s), 1st item Liandry's, and Sion's charged-Q window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions that apply here reach the page nowhere, and breakdown.cooldowns wastes its second slot repeating Decimating Smash instead. (a) Glory in Death: Sion reanimates on death with rapid attacks that HEAL him and deal bonus damage based on your maximum health — the corpse is a real threat and anti-heal decides it. (b) Both Glory in Death and Soul Furnace deal max-health damage, so stacking raw armour/MR is the wrong answer. (c) Unstoppable Onslaught is a 7500-range charge that creates terrain and can cut your retreat, and Mordekaiser has no dash. Also unstated: Decimating Smash only knocks up if charged long enough — a quick tap is damage only.
audit.why: Each changes a real decision: hold Grievous Wounds for the zombie rather than spending it early, build health/burn rather than flat resists, and keep Flash for the wall rather than the damage.
audit.corrected: Decimating Smash 10/9/8/7/6s, knockup only on a long charge. Soul Furnace 15-11s shield, recasts after 3s for max-health magic damage. Roar of the Slayer 800 range, 12-8s, shreds armour. Unstoppable Onslaught 140/100/60s, 7500 range, cuts retreat — hold Flash for the wall. Glory in Death heals him off attacks and hits max health.

edits.after: Neither of you has an all-in at 1 — you hold Q, he wants to charge a smash. Farm off the cone tip and never stand in a charging Decimating Smash.

edits.before: W banks a cut of the damage you deal and take as shield-health. Short Q-auto trades now come out even or better because half the return damage gets absorbed.
edits.after: W banks a cut of the damage you deal and take as shield-health, so a single-target Obliterate plus that bank out-trades his lone Roar of the Slayer poke.
